text:
hannah.cs: Heads-up: NorthStar reserved pool scheduled for cutover tomorrow 09:30 PT. Final checklist: quota confirmation, autoscale policy, short smoke+soak. Who can own verification window?

raj.eng: I got autoscale validation. What are target SLOs and desired burst headroom?

hannah.cs: SLOs: p95 < 220ms, errors < 0.35%. Customer requested 25% burst allowance first 30m. Also they want quantized fallback (q4/q8) available if latency degrades.

claire.ops: Provisioned quota: eu-west-1a=40, eu-west-1b=30, eu-west-1c=30. Commit: ns-commit-2026-03-23. Finance pre-approved short bump +1 replica for up to 45m if needed.

ben.sre: Recommend start with autoscale policy "staggered" (scale_step=1 replica / 45s) for first 20m, then switch to "baseline-fast". This reduces kernel JIT thrash and GC spikes.

raj.eng: Plan two runs:
- steady: 60% expected QPS for 15m (validate p95 steady)
- ramp-soak: 0->100% over 4m, hold 12m, cool 8m (validate burst and fallback)
Runner: vegeta from distributed runners. Example:
```bash
echo 'POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' | vegeta attack -rate=250 -duration=16m | vegeta report
```

hannah.cs: Capture KV hit-rate, kernel/JIT logs, quantized-model switch latency, and token-cost delta. Upload to S3 and post links.

ops-bot: Artifact uploaded s3://redwood-ops/northstar/bringup/1839998888/steady-v1.tar.gz

raj.eng: Steady run results: p95=200ms, errors=0.18%, KV hit-rate=79%, cpu avg 69%. Artifact: https://s3.aws/redwood/northstar/1839998888/steady-report.zip

raj.eng: Ramp-soak (staggered) results: initial cold window ~80s with p95=430ms while one node JIT'd kernels, then settled to 215ms. No OOMs. artifacts: https://s3.aws/redwood/northstar/1839998888/ramp-staggered.zip

raj.eng: Ramp-soak (burst) results: avoided JIT tail but CPU spiked 90% on two hosts, short GC pauses; p95 peaked 360ms. artifacts: https://s3.aws/redwood/northstar/1839998888/ramp-burst.zip

ben.sre: Observations: quantized fallback q8 warms faster but has ~3-6% higher error-rate on a small prompt subset. Cache-warm lambda helps: we can push top prefixes to KV before cutover and eliminate most of the cold window.

claire.ops: I can enable cache-warm lambda and pre-populate prefixes. Also set up short-term +1 replica if we flip to warm-replica fallback. Portal id: quota-NS-321.

hannah.cs: Decision: enable cache-warm lambda + start with "staggered" autoscale for first 25m. If p95>350ms for >60s, auto-fallback to warm-replica (+1) and route 10% to quantized q8 variant. Ben, add rollback steps. Raj, run final verification at 08:50 PT and upload artifacts.

ben.sre: Rollback steps added to runbook: disable cache-warm, spin warm replica, enable fallback routing, and notify AE. Watch window 09:15-10:15 PT.

raj.eng: Final verification scheduled 08:50 PT. Tagging @ben.sre. :eyes:

ops-bot: Final upload s3://redwood-ops/northstar/bringup/1839998888/final-bundle.tar.gz

hannah.cs: Thanks all. I'll update the AE and customer and confirm post-cutover check-in at 11:00 PT.
